claims.verbatim:
Sld 23d, Erin (s), Cutting, and Royal Standard (s), Whine-

claims.citation: New York Herald, 9 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Erin (Br), Cutting, Liverpool May 25, via
Queenstown 26th, with mdse and 413 passengers, to the Na-
tional Steam Navigation Co. Experienced light, variable
winds all the passage. May 26, passed steamships Scotia
and Louisiana, hence for Liverpool; June 1, one of the Na-
tional Company's steamers, bound E; 5th, steamship Amer-
ica, hence for Bremen.
